purpose: Destructive blind test for the promoted metadata candidate that prefix-family signs before 806 produce a distinct 46x/47x series continuation, unlike nonprefix 806 rows.

design.control_class: catalogued nonprefix 806 rows, including terminal and 806-002 continuation cases
design.neutralization: Printed object labels are cropped out; panels expose only neutral IDs BS001..BS012.

promotion_rule: The candidate strengthens only if blind readers recover a distinct local visual pattern for prefix-806-successor rows and do not mark nonprefix-806 controls as the same structure at comparable rates.
failure_rule: If prefix and nonprefix 806 rows cannot be separated blind, the metadata-layer role split remains unpromoted and may be catalog/segmentation driven.
